ELK / elkjs source availability

This archive provides the preferred-form sources assembled from the upstream
elkjs 0.9.3 release's declared ELK v0.9.1 plus PR955 lineage, the JS wrapper and
build configuration, and the runtime source JARs identified in MANIFEST.json.
Source/patch copyrights and original license notices are preserved.

ELK/elkjs and Xbase/Xtend sources are available under their included EPL-2.0
terms. EMF-GWT common/ecore sources retain EPL-1.0 terms. Original Apache and
additional notices are retained for GWT/Guava. See notices/ and source headers.
Brabbler has not added functional engine-source modifications.

README.md describes source identities, validation and the upstream traceability
limitation. No legal certification or byte-identical upstream build is claimed.
The separate source asset accompanies the Brabbler release; its application
NOTICE and SOURCE-AVAILABILITY.json identify the versioned locator and checksum.
